parameters.content:
## Compare
One request for up to 25 stocks. Every stock is one item with the same columns (price, change, market cap, P/E, RSI, 52-week position, analyst view; Pro adds rating and AI score).

**Rank By** sorts the items and adds a `rank` field. A symbol Stocklake does not know comes back as an item with `found: false` and an `error`; the others are still compared.
